bagPolicy.summary: Fishers Event Center enforces a clear bag policy where bags must be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”. Non-clear bags smaller than 4.5” x 6.5” are permitted.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Clear diaper bags with a child
prohibited: Bags with oversized content preventing visibility
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection. Clear diaper bags are allowed if they accompany a child.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the page. Visitors are encouraged to use the Waze app for real-time traffic updates and directions. Consider arriving early to find parking and comply with the clear bag policy for quicker entry.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Fishers Event Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Fishers Event Center offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan choices. Highlights include locally sourced items from Indiana vendors and eco-friendly initiatives. Outside food is generally not allowed, with some exceptions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Fishers Event Center’s Sensory Room, located in the Guest Services Center near Section 109, is available for guests with sensory sensitivities. For assistance or directions to the Sensory Room on event day, please check in at the Guest Services Center at Section 109.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fishers Event Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Therefore, Will Call will not be available at the Fishers Event Center Ticket Office. The Ticket Office is located near the Plaza, adjacent to the main doors. ‍ Children under the age of 2 will be admitted into Fishers Event Center without a ticket provided that they sit on an adult's lap and do not occupy a seat.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fishers Event Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
